svg.title: FPV video ecosystem compatibility overview
svg.desc: An overview matrix shows that analog camera and analog VTX pair with an appropriate analog receiver, while DJI O3/O4, Walksnail Avatar and HDZero need their specifically supported goggles or receivers. Exact model and firmware compatibility must be checked.
svg.text: VIDEO ECOSYSTEMS — MATCH THE AIR SIDE AND GROUND SIDE
Concept map only; the supported-model list is authoritative.

g.text: Analog camera → analog VTX → matching analog VRX / goggles
Band/channel, antenna, connector and polarization still matter.
Generation-specific camera/air unit → goggles supported by DJI
O3, standard O4 and O4 Pro have different specs/pairing rules.
Avatar camera/air unit → explicitly supported Avatar goggles/VRX
Check the official buying/compatibility table and firmware notes.
Compatible camera + HDZero VTX → HDZero-compatible receiver/goggles
VTX board dimensions, input voltage, weight and power vary by model.
“HD” means cross-brand compatible, or a DJI camera drone is a DIY FPV air unit.
Check exact model, camera cable, firmware, goggles generation, power, antenna and regional settings.
